definitions.explanation: A list of dishes to be served or available at a meal.
The plan for what meals to prepare over a period of time.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}の{献立|こんだて}は{何|なん}ですか。
{一週間|いっしゅうかん}の{献立|こんだて}を{考|かんが}える。
examples.english: I plan the menu for the week.

examples.japanese: {栄養|えいよう}バランスのいい{献立|こんだて}を{作|つく}りたい。
examples.english: I want to create a menu with good nutritional balance.

notes:
COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{献立|こんだて}を{考|かんが}える (to plan a menu)
・{献立|こんだて}を{決|き}める (to decide on a menu)
・{献立|こんだて}{表|ひょう} (menu chart)
・{本日|ほんじつ}の{献立|こんだて} (today's menu)

USAGE: More commonly used for home cooking or school lunches than restaurant menus (メニュー is often used for restaurants).
